parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` and `TrackContainerProtocol` in the `Playback` package share three identical members — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, and `pageToken:String?` — and differ only in the concrete type of `item` (`Show` vs `Track`). This is the canonical PAT pattern: the varying slot (`item`) becomes an `associatedtype Item`, and the three shared members lift into the new protocol body. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies. Introducing `ContainerProtocol<Item>` eliminates the structural duplication while preserving full type safety for each concrete container.
